All 55 items now carry references taken from the licensed text, each with a page and a quote containing the citation, except 1AD.1 and 1AD.41, which have no standalone statutory citation (1AD.1 is the general minimum-disclosure rule; 1AD.41 introduces 1AD.42–1AD.45). Topic text no longer embeds citations; statuteRef is the single authority.
